request.spec:
A steward can re-settle a SETTLED claim (anyone else, or any other status, or a claim in a closed
period, is refused with an error on the claim). Re-settling freezes the claim again at the figure
it would have today as an open claim bound by no statement: today's rates, grades, floor and late
charge. The status log gains a SETTLED line for it, and CLAIM_RESETTLED is written, naming the
claim like every claim line, ending old=<previous figure> new=<new figure>.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A steward can re-settle a SETTLED claim (anyone else, or any other status, or a claim in a closed
period, is refused with an error on the claim). Re-settling freezes the claim again at the figure
it would have today as an open claim bound by no statement: today's rates, grades, floor and late
charge. The status log gains a SETTLED line for it, and CLAIM_RESETTLED is written, naming the
claim like every claim line, ending old=<previous figure> new=<new figure>.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A steward can now re-settle a settled claim. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**Server:** a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/claims/{claimId}/resettle`, defined in `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/sheets/{sheetId}/claims/{claimId}/resettle.POST.yml`. It follows the same steps as the existing claim status change.
- **Refusals:** it refuses a claim dated in a closed period (using the existing check), anyone who isn't a steward, and any claim that isn't SETTLED. A refusal writes nothing.
- **New figure:** the claim is frozen again at what it would be today as an open claim with no statement binding it. That is the current rate for the person's grade, at least the floor, plus the late charge as of the sheet's today. Statement figures are ignored.
  - For the late charge, I added `onAsOpen` and `dueAsOpen` to `LateCharge.java`. The existing method returns zero for any claim that isn't open, and a re-settle needs the charge calculated as if the claim were open.
- **Records:** it writes `CLAIM_RESETTLED … number=<n> old=<previous> new=<new>` (`n/a` when there's no figure) and adds a SETTLED line to the claim's status log. ROLLUP and TOTALS lines are still written only when the figures change, so re-settling at the same figure adds just the CLAIM_RESETTLED line.
- **New classes** in `claim/`: `ResettleRequest`, `ValidateResettle`, `ApplyResettle`, `Resettled` and `RecordClaimResettled`.

**Front end:** each claim row now has a "Re-settle" button (`claim-resettle`) in `features/claims/status.slot.tsx`. A refusal shows in the row's existing `claim-error`, and taking any other action on that claim clears it.

No database change was needed, because the new figure goes into the claim's existing `settled_due` column.
